<details open>

model: Add support for SenseNova U1 model (#28919)

* model : add SenseNova U1 understanding support

Add support for the dense SenseNova U1 understanding branch, including
the U1.5-8B-MoT model.

- Add HF-to-GGUF conversion for NEOChatModel, excluding MoT generation
  tensors and concatenating temporal and spatial Q/K normalization
  weights.
- Register the sensenova_u1 GGUF architecture and custom spatial RoPE
  metadata.
- Implement temporal/spatial Q/K normalization with 4-axis RoPE.
- Keep U1-specific text position handling in the model implementation.
- Add synthetic architecture coverage for sensenova_u1.

Only the dense understanding branch is supported; generation
branches are intentionally rejected during conversion.

* conversion : treat one-expert SenseNova U1 configs as dense

* mtmd : add SenseNova U1 vision support

Add conversion support for the SenseNova U1 vision encoder and implement
its CPU mtmd projector graph.

The graph applies patch embedding, GELU, adjacent-pair 2D RoPE, spatial
downsampling, and dense projection for dynamic-resolution image inputs.

* mtmd : fix SenseNova U1 vision token layout

* model : clean up SenseNova U1 RoPE metadata

Replace the hard-coded spatial RoPE key with shared GGUF and LLM_KV
definitions used by conversion, model loading, and architecture tests.

Clarify why SenseNova U1 retains its custom text-position input: U1 uses
[t, 0, 0, 0], while the generic M-RoPE input uses [t, t, t, 0].

* mtmd : simplify SenseNova U1 projector integration

Map the SenseNova U1 dense projection to the standard mm.0 weight and
bias tensors and reuse the shared projector fields in the loader and graph.

items.name: b11800
items.body:
<details open>

llama: create new fused op for QSA mask (#30640)

* llama: create new fused op for QSA scoring

* enroll glm5.3-next too

* tests : initialize the remaining tensors in test_kpool_mask

The harness sentinels were left uninitialized, so leftover memory could read as NaN and fail the NaN check.

* ggml: generalize the k-pool mask op into ggml_top_k_mask

The k-pool mask op only covered the pooled QSA selection of qwen4exp
and glm5-next, while the DSA models and the DeepSeek V4 CSA build the
same top-k mask by hand with fill, set_rows and add.

ggml_top_k_mask(mask, top_k, score, blocks, extra) keeps the mask
cells of the live picks and the extra cells, and sets the rest to
-inf. Every row tensor is 4D in the layout of top_k, and the mask is
broadcast to those rows, so a selection can also be made per head.
score, blocks and extra are optional: without score every pick is
live, without blocks a pick is a cell, and extra holds the cells a
row keeps without a pick.

llm_graph_context::build_fused_top_k_mask views the row tensors in
the layout of kq_mask and registers the fused node. The k-pool
models, the DSA attention of build_attn and the DeepSeek V4 CSA mask
use it when the probe enables the op, and keep their current path on
backends without it.

---------

Co-authored-by: Pascal <admin@serveurperso.com>

</details>
